title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: next best actions from Customer Intent Agent in the Copilot pane
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, administrator opt-in, documented settings and Dataverse update operations are supported. Minor corrections should complete the experience-profile assignment directions and align the governance checklist with the controls it actually lists.

claims.claim: Customer Intent Agent provides next best actions for a case in the Copilot pane.
claims.quote: Next best actions use Customer Intent Agent to recommend next steps for a case in the Copilot pane.

claims.claim: The agent analyzes the case context after a case is created or updated.
claims.quote: After a case is created or updated, the agent analyzes the case context, such as emails and notes

claims.quote: Follow up with the customer to gather or confirm additional details.

claims.claim: The printed Copilot Service admin center path reaches Actions on the Intent-based suggestions page.
claims.quote: Select Productivity in Support experience. ... Select Manage for Intent-based suggestions. ... In the Turn on intent-based suggestions section ... Actions: Select to enable next best actions for cases
claims.fix: Keep the switch path. For the same row's experience-profile assignment, add to its note: 'On the Intent-based suggestions page, under Enable in experience profiles, select Select experience profiles and choose one or more profiles.' The cited page documents this additional branch.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Copilot features page requires production-use licensing and refers readers to the Dynamics 365 Licensing Guide.
claims.quote: Meet the licensing requirements for using the feature with production environments. Learn more in the Dynamics 365 Licensing Guide.

claims.claim: The Copilot features page itself names no specific license for next best actions.
claims.quote: Searched: "next best actions" "licens"; Dynamics 365 Customer Service Copilot features Enterprise Premium license production environments licensing. Read configure-copilot-features, including prerequisites and next-best-actions setup; it links the guide without naming a feature-specific license.

claims.quote: Prerequisites ... Set up a pay-as-you-go plan.

claims.claim: Selected Dynamics 365 Copilot and agent capabilities use consumption-based billing with Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Selected Copilot and agent capabilities in Dynamics 365 use consumption-based billing, charging per use. These capabilities use Copilot Credits for AI interactions and tasks
